verdict.rationale: An official AWS Pricing Calculator exists at calculator.aws [aws-docs-51], and the public Free Tier page publishes credit terms ($100 up front, up to $200 over 6 months) [aws-docs-18, aws-docs-30]. However, the evidence never shows public per-service pricing pages or describes how the calculator estimates a multi-service stack. Community complaints about pricing opaqueness and paying separately per service [aws-comm-2, aws-comm-9] are skepticism, not a concrete contradiction, so they lower confidence rather than create a dispute. Missing for 10: evidence of public per-service pricing pages, documentation of the calculator's stack-estimation workflow, independent hands-on corroboration of pre-signup estimates.
